description: Responsive dashboard optimized for both mobile and laptop screens, with touch-friendly controls and readable text.

props.text: Responsive dashboard optimized for both mobile and laptop screens, with touch-friendly controls and readable text.

props.title: Fluid grid layout that stacks vertically on mobile (< 768px) and displays in columns on laptop (>= 768px)
Assignment cards with flexible width (100% on mobile, constrained max-width on laptop)
Touch-friendly buttons minimum 44x44px tap target on mobile devices
Responsive typography with minimum 16px base font size on mobile, scaling appropriately for laptop
Form inputs with adequate spacing and sizing for mobile touch interaction
Viewport meta tag to ensure proper scaling on mobile browsers
CSS media queries for breakpoints at 768px (tablet) and 1024px (laptop)
Flexible assignment card layout showing title, unit code, due date with appropriate wrapping
Color-coded status indicators (red for overdue, orange for upcoming, green for completed) visible on all screen sizes
Add assignment button positioned accessibly on both mobile and desktop
Completion checkbox/button sized appropriately for touch on mobile
